decision: A3 does NOT authorize brace_east_shelf, chock_west_ramp, or extract_outcrop. No cost, yield, cooldown, source mapping, or capability grant is approved. The world adapter has no Quarry binding and rejects Quarry intents fail-closed.

brace_east_shelf.reason: A8's 2-oak value is explicitly S2 fixture-only, not a price. No native collision/route proof shows the east brace creates a safe, materially distinct route; no A3 sink/source model compares this one-time investment against existing relay/station/tool costs.

chock_west_ramp.reason: A8's 2-stone value is explicitly S2 fixture-only. No native proof shows the west chock is a real alternative rather than a duplicate toll; no durable A1/A0 physical instance id exists.

extract_outcrop.reason: live_stone_chunk is generic (poi_id null, SOH_PROPOSAL). A8's 2-stone/45s values are fixture-only. No site-bound source record, active-time replenishment authority, or net-yield model exists. A guessed 1-item price would not satisfy the gate.

existing_stone_sources: live_stone_chunk generic harvest (2 per claim, 480 active s, LIVE_EXISTING_NODES)
missing_for_quarry: A1/A0 durable physical instance id for poi_crown_south_quarry
native collision/route proof for both paid alternatives and leave_unworked
A3 net-yield model: route cost + travel/exposure vs expected stone over replenishment cycles
active-time cooldown authority bound to the site, not wall-clock or fixture memory
human pacing evidence that the Quarry is a meaningful return trip, not a filler toll

fail_closed_behavior: world_action({poi_id:poi_crown_south_quarry,...}) returns unknown_world_poi/unknown_world_action. Caller-supplied costs/rewards/flags are rejected as invalid_world_request_field. A7 BLK-5 remains OPEN_BY_DESIGN until real evidence is supplied; it must not be closed by stamping a guessed quantity.
next_atomic_action: A8/A1/A0 supply a durable site instance and native two-route collision/reload proof; A3 then models cost/yield/cooldown against the existing stone/oak graph and issues a new authorization SHA. No production grant before that.
